question: Who alone is the speaker of the scriptures and the source of their injunctions?
premises: This one is the speaker of the scriptures.
No other is the speaker of the scriptures.
Hari is also the injunction itself.
inference: Hari alone is both the speaker of the scriptures and their authoritative injunction.
plain_english: This Hari alone is indeed the speaker of the scriptures; no other is. He is also the injunction itself.
